trellis2.input: bear cut-out, ComfyUI core Trellis.2 graph with baked PBR
trellis2.note: Detailed shape with a 4K bake. Lit from the side the fur reads pale; the input was a stock cut-out bear.

hunyuan3d.note: Clean shape, no colour. Earlier black-background runs built a wall behind the bear, so cut-outs now go on white.

triposplat.input: bear cut-out, Gaussian splat and clip
triposplat.note: Real from every side, a little blotchy on the back. Peak from its earlier mug run.

triposr.note: Fast, soft shape, recognisable from all sides.

shap_e.note: A believable small chair from words alone.

moge.input: a room photo, a one-sided relief
moge.note: Only what the camera saw, with a hole behind anything in front. On a dark product shot with glass it gave scattered fragments.

sam_3d_body.input: a generated clip of a walking figure, pose as a stick-figure GLB
sam_3d_body.note: Body pose over a clip; the turntable shows the pose file.

skintokens.note: 36 bones, a pose test moved 52533 of 226530 vertices. Skin weights tear in a hard pose on this rough mesh: looked at, not a finished rig.

kimodo.input: words: a person walks forward, then waves with the right hand
kimodo.note: 150 frames, 78 joints; the hips travel about 6 m and the hand comes up. Looked at as a stick figure.

anigen.note: 33 bones with weights on every vertex. A hard test pose stretches it badly: looked at, not a finished rig.
